text: Before mainnet, Desmond Okoro and Julian Hargrove close out a final readiness checklist -- and Vivian Castellan kicks off the audit.
Desmond tightens gas usage and walks every function's access control; Julian finishes the deployment and incident docs.
Every item is clean except one -- the dedicated internal security audit the team planned for from the start.
Vivian formally kicks it off: Naomi Fitzwilliam's only job now is to try to break this contract before a real attacker does.
Next: what Naomi finds, on day one of the audit.
